title: Solar for All provides long-term electric bill relief
discussion_signal: The post frames Solar for All as a low-income household bill-relief and infrastructure program whose value depends on continued funding, state workplans, and long-lived asset performance. It also makes contestation visible: public savings claims are being defended through legal and political action.
linked_research_question: When public energy programs report household savings, what determines whether those savings persist through implementation, funding conflict, and asset life?
limits: The post is advocacy and includes modeled or program-level savings claims
Potential savings are not individual realized savings
Legal discussion does not establish final program persistence
